en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5675 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ibn Mihzam, from Talhah ibn Zayd, who said that
"Child in the womb (hamil) will not inherit except with clear evidence."
Imam (as) explained: "The hamil is the child carried by a pregnant woman who was captured while pregnant, and later the father or the brother recognizes the child as theirs."
